scientific_integrity: Proof uses explicit 12-form specialization, determinant nonvanishing, exact local contact orders and Bezout exhaustion; computer verification reproduces identities and finite-field spot checks.
scientific_limitations: Fixed cyclotomic coefficient model with omega mapping to 1 in characteristic 3, parameter t neither 0 nor 1. Classification is of reduced geometric support only; no claim about nonreduced singular scheme or alternative models. Priority is subject to bibliographic incompleteness.
title: A four-conic characteristic-three boundary of the twelve-conic Hesse arrangement
